summary: One-frame event added to a sound camera by ecl::sound::CameraSystem::CheckSoundTriggersToUpdateSoundVolumes when the camera enters another sound volume trigger; read by ecl::crowds::SoundVolumeSystem and ecl::sound::AmbienceMixSystem.

fields.name: OldSoundVolume
fields.evidence: EoCClient.dll+0xDCC2F0 (event add, ComponentFrameStorageAllocRaw 0x18) writes *param_3 at +0; the caller CheckSoundTriggersToUpdateSoundVolumes (EoCClient.dll+0xDD0760) passes local_200 = SoundCameraComponent.SoundVolume read before it is overwritten. Live: entity handles / null.

fields.name: NewSoundVolume
fields.evidence: Same add: +8 = *param_4 = the SoundCameraComponent after its +0 was set to the new trigger's entity.

fields.name: PlayerId
fields.evidence: Same add: *(short*)(+0x10) = *param_5, the short player id the check runs for (stored also in SoundCameraComponent +0x34). Live: 1.

fields.name: field_12
fields.evidence: Same add: byte +0x12 = *param_6 (a bool argument of the check, probably the 'notify/force' flag). Live: 0.

fields.name: _Pad13
fields.evidence: not written by the add; live bytes vary (uninitialised).

open_questions: Meaning of the byte at +0x12; the event add's two extra stack arguments were not traced to their source.
